value.rationale: Example 5.11 is the first simple rank-three unisolvent system beyond the complete rank-two classification. Its swept variety is a naturally distinguished degree-seven threefold whose singular geometry the originating paper leaves undetermined. The precise decomposition into a quartic and two boundary lines, degree six and incidence, distinguish it from the rank-two tangent-developable model and provide a concrete input for conductor/normality and local degeneration work; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
